items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I'm writing a score now for about eight pieces. Like I did with the Kansas City Six and the -- Bob Barney's Buddies

ctx.x: It'd be wonderful if you could do it.

I will, because that -- see, I'm writing a score now for about eight pieces. Like I did with the Kansas City Six and the -- Bob Barney's Buddies, but for what I got in mind I need another couple of more instruments, maybe one more, because I got a particular sound I want to get and I had my guitar special built for it, but I don't use it in public.
What instrumentation have you got for this eight pieces?
